title: English Practice Quiz 0990
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The committee reached a decision after a lengthy ___.
questions.explanation: Deliberation is careful discussion before making a decision.

questions.question: The evidence was too limited to ___.
questions.explanation: Substantiate means support a claim with evidence.

questions.question: Her explanation was concise, yet remarkably ___.
questions.explanation: Comprehensive means complete and covering the important points.

questions.question: The new policy will come ___ effect next month.
questions.explanation: The established expression is come into effect.

questions.question: No sooner had the announcement been made ___ questions began.
questions.explanation: The correlative structure is no sooner...than.

questions.question: His remarks were intended to ___ tension between the teams.
questions.explanation: Alleviate means make a problem or feeling less severe.

questions.question: The proposal is attractive; ___, its costs remain uncertain.
questions.explanation: Nevertheless introduces a contrast with the preceding statement.

questions.question: The manager asked that every application ___ reviewed carefully.
questions.explanation: The mandative subjunctive uses the base form be.

questions.question: The two reports are broadly similar, but they are not ___.
The project was abandoned due to a lack ___ funding.
questions.explanation: The correct collocation is lack of funding.
